##### Network exposure mappings

While [graphs](#def-graph) tell us *who* is connected, we need a way to incorporate the information they contain into the structural equations that define the variables of the model.  [*Network exposure mappings*](#def-network-exposure-mapping) do this by turning the vector of neighbors’ treatments into a scalar quantity — for example, the count or proportion of treated neighbors.  Together with graphs, exposure mappings allow us to formalize how interference operates:  graphs define the structure of possible influence across units, while network exposure mappings define how each unit incorporates that influence in its own measures.
